title: Siege of Changchun
note: Starvation siege June-October 1948; civilian toll disputed (150,000-300,000); official PRC silence. Need scholarly sources (Tanner on Liaoshen, Du Bin).

title: Land reform in the People's Republic of China, 1950-1953
note: Agrarian Reform Law 30 June 1950; redistribution to ~300 million peasants; killings 1-2 million (contested); Javed 2017 dissertation, Dikotter, Wemheuer; include peasant women's land rights.

title: Marriage Law of the People's Republic of China
note: Women's rights under the new state; promulgated 1 May 1950; no opened source in the parent record so women's experience is a gap.

title: Retreat of the Republic of China government to Taiwan
note: Dates 7-10 December 1949; 1.2 million mainlanders; martial law from May 1949; links to 228 incident and Taiwan status.

title: Huaihai Campaign
note: 6 November 1948 - 10 January 1949, largest battle of the civil war; PLA figure 555,000 Nationalist losses; need independent scholarly figures.

title: February 28 Incident in Taiwan
note: Nationalist suppression of Taiwanese uprising; shapes Taiwan's relations with arriving mainlanders; Taiwanese perspective under-recorded.
